actions.action: Finger-test soil moisture 3 inches into root ball and bed soil
If wet, withhold water until top 2 inches dry
If dry, slowly trickle about 2 gallons per plant over root ball every other day

reason: The answer blames overwatering and root rot when the actual problem was underwatering in heat. Its main push to water less (every 3-5 days) is the opposite of the daily watering that fixed it, and despite the soil check it likely delays the fix; it also never mentions shade.
